h:
ComfyUI 的六网格工作流程的 Beta 版本，可帮助您通过一个提示测试不同的检查点，以便了解哪一个最适合您。

Can be used with a wide variety of bases, like SDXL and PonyXL.

如果您是 Comfy 新手，则稍微高级一些。

Be advised that loading six models will need a little patience.

更多信息即将到来。

o.en:
Beta version of a six grid workflow for ComfyUI that helps you test different checkpoints with one prompt in order to see which one is best for you.

Can be used with a wide variety of bases, like SDXL and PonyXL.

Slightly advanced if you're new to Comfy.

Be advised that loading six models will need a little patience.

More info to come.
